claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only the Nikon D7000 body; no test shots, menu/screen, or functional checks are shown.
Witness photos do not show batteries or battery compartments.

claims.claim: I am selling with a silicone case.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show the camera body and a lens cap; no silicone case is shown.
Witness report reads Nikon branding and “D7000” marking on the camera body.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or misrepresentation (seller says Canon, witness identifies Nikon D7000).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the top plate/model label and the front/back branding (or a close-up of the model text) matching what is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Nikon D7000 body only (worst-case: no lens, untested), not as a Canon kit.

risks.risk: No lens included (photos show only the body and a lens cap).
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached to the camera and/or a separate photo of the lens model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (worst-case: body without lens).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (sensor, mirror, shutter, and optics not shown; no screen/EVF check).
risks.proof: Video/clip of powering on (LCD/EVF visible), plus a close-up of the lens mount/sensor area and a short test shot.
Photos laid out showing all included items: batteries (2), charger, memory card, cables, straps, caps, and any manuals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body only with no guaranteed accessories.

risks.risk: Physical damage risk (camera appears inside/against damaged cardboard; no close-up of body condition).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners, mount area, and any dents/scratches; also a photo of the tripod mount and ports.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the exact model/branding labels (top plate and right-side marking) to confirm Nikon D7000.
Show whether a lens is included: photo with lens attached and/or separate lens photos with model/serial.
Provide a short video of powering on: LCD/EVF working, menus visible, and a quick test shot.
Show the included items laid out: 2 batteries, charger, memory card, cables, and the silicone case (if any).
Send close-ups of the sensor/mirror area (through the mount) and the lens mount contacts, plus body condition at corners/ports.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item as a Nikon D7000 camera body (not Canon) and shows no lens attached; seller functionality/accessory claims are not supported by the photos, so it should be priced at the worst-case untested, body-only scenario.
